summary: Frontend-only test of the merged CloudIVR sidebar (12 links + section tab strips). Desktop 1920: exactly 12 links in 4 groups (home:3, numbers:1, calling:5, account:3); all 7 old nav ids absent. Numbers/Calls/Campaigns open the right default tab, every tab navigates and keeps its parent sidebar link active; numbers/:phone, orders/:id, verification, campaigns/new, campaigns/:id keep the right parent active and show tabs. The 9 non-tab pages show no tabs and only their own link active; Overview active only on /app. Page titles correct ('Buy a number · CloudIVR' etc.). Search palette finds Buy a number / Do-not-call list / Text-to-voice calls and navigates. Mobile 390 + 320: bottom nav works, Numbers tab highlighted on /app/buy, More menu lists exactly the 8 merged links (+ channel/suggest), More highlighted on /app/campaigns, tab strip scrolls (overflow-x auto) with no page overflow (scrollWidth == viewport). No page errors. One mobile UX issue found.

ui_bugs.issue: On narrow screens the active tab is not scrolled into view. At 320px on /app/sip, tab-sip sits at x=659-814, off screen, so the user can't see which tab they are on. The scrollbar is hidden and there's no fade/edge cue, so it isn't obvious the strip scrolls. Fix: scrollIntoView({inline:'nearest'}) on the active tab when the pathname changes, and/or add an edge fade.

issues: Typing 'Buy a number' shows two entries with the same label: palette-item-page-tab-buy (page) and palette-item-act-buy (action). Minor duplicate.

action_items: Optional: auto-scroll the active section tab into view on mobile (SectionTabs.js), plus an overflow fade cue
Optional: remove the duplicate 'Buy a number' in the palette (page vs action)
